items.name: Hierophant's Red Cord
items.lore: Won from Hierophant Cadan when the Crimson Rite was broken. Thirteen knots, all burned through.

items.name: Silver-Bristle Charm
items.lore: A silver bristle from Grugyn, the Twrch Trwyth's son, bound in red thread.

items.name: Door-Breaker's Horn
items.lore: Won from Gorgoth the Door-Breaker. It still smells of brimstone.
